outcome: Malignant masses (invasive duct carcinoma, inflammatory carcinoma, adenocarcinoma)
cohort: The study included 500 pregnant women (190 primigravida, 254 multigravida) and 56 lactating women attending Kasr Al Ainy outpatient clinic with breast complaints.
finding: The incidence of breast mass was 25.6%, and within those cases, 5.46% had PABC, leading to an overall PABC incidence of 1.4% in the studied population, with most breast masses being benign.
cross-section timing: At the time of presentation with breast complaints during pregnancy or lactation
